FISHING LICENCE · MEXICO

Mexico fishing licence

Visitors need an individual permit for recreational fishing from a boat or underwater. Shore fishing has a permit exemption, but catch limits and closed seasons still apply.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Mexican and foreign anglers fishing from boats.
  • Underwater recreational anglers.

Who doesn’t

  • Recreational fishing from land does not require the national permit.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Individual 1-dayany1 dayMXN 204
Individual 1-weekany7 daysMXN 510
Individual 1-monthany1 monthMXN 766
Individual 1-yearany1 yearMXN 1021

Saltwater

The shore exemption also applies at sea. Boat fishing requires a permit; marine protected areas have their own restrictions.

Fishing with a guide or charter

Baja California requires each person who fishes from a boat to hold an individual permit. Confirm whether the charter purchases it for you.

Rules visitors should know

  • Follow the minimum sizes, closed seasons, catch limits and permitted gear.
  • Do not sell a recreational catch.
  • CONANP's Cabo Pulmo visitor page states that fishing inside the park is prohibited.

How to buy

Use CONAPESCA's e5cinco service or the official Baja California permit shop. Baja California Sur also sells permits through FONMAR.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Mexico?

Visitors need an individual permit for recreational fishing from a boat or underwater. Shore fishing has a permit exemption, but catch limits and closed seasons still apply.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Mexico?

Individual 1-day: MXN 204; Individual 1-week: MXN 510; Individual 1-month: MXN 766; Individual 1-year: MXN 1021 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Mexico?

Use CONAPESCA's e5cinco service or the official Baja California permit shop. Baja California Sur also sells permits through FONMAR.
